components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the current server date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already
            lives at the same address with the same last name (a shared household).
            Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted as '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: The owner's membership tier. 'SILVER' when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0) and an email address is present, otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners who live in the same household (same last name and address), assigned when an owner joins an existing household via 'sharesHousehold'. Null for owners not in a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'H-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners, at the moment this owner was created, sharing the same first and last name (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets

              items:

## Summary

I changed the `customerCode` format from `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` to `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` with a per-city sequence.

**Changes:**

1. **`CustomerCode.java`** — the formatting utility now takes `city` as well and produces `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`. Extracted a private `prefix(...)` helper so the CITY3/LAST3 truncate-and-uppercase logic isn't duplicated.

2. **`AssignCustomerCode.java`** — the sequence is now per-city (one more than the owners already in that city) instead of global. The count runs over `ownerRepository.findAll()` before the new owner is saved, so it reflects prior state.

3. **`Cities.java`** (new) — a small helper mirroring the existing `Namesakes` helper, owning the "same city" matching (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, case-insensitive). This keeps city-matching semantics out of `AssignCustomerCode`, matching the codebase's existing pattern (`CountNamesakes`/`Namesakes`).

4. **`openapi.yml`** — updated the `customerCode` and `membershipNumber` descriptions and examples to the new format.

**Values derived from `customerCode`:** `membershipNumber` in `OwnerMapper` builds on `owner.getCustomerCode()` directly (`<customerCode>-M<YY>`), so it automatically rebuilds on the new format — e.g. `LON-SMI-0007-M26`. No other value derives from `customerCode` (membership tier is based on namesakes/email, not the code).

The new format is at most 12 chars, well within the DB's `VARCHAR(20)` `customer_code` column.
